name: pinpawo-agent
description: Open-source PinPawo agent runtime, local agent, and desktop companion.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pinpawo/agent-contracts && npm run build -w @pinpawo/agent-session && npm run build -w @pinpawo/pet-agent && npm run build -w pinpawo && npm run build -w @pinpawo/studio && npm run build -w @pinpawo-plugin/studio-http && npm run build -w @pinpawo-plugin/kanban && npm run build -w @pinpawo-plugin/scheduler && npm run build -w @pinpawo-plugin/trigger && npm run build -w @pinpawo/studio-console
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pinpawo/agent-contracts && npm run test -w @pinpawo/pet-agent && npm run test -w @pinpawo/studio && npm run test -w @pinpawo/agent-session && npm run test -w @pinpawo/tui && npm run test -w @pinpawo-toolkit/browser && npm run test -w @pinpawo-plugin/kanban && npm run test -w @pinpawo-plugin/scheduler && npm run test -w @pinpawo-plugin/trigger && npm run test -w @pinpawo-plugin/studio-http && npm run test -w @pinpawo-tests/studio-e2e && npm run test:unit -w pinpawo
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pinpawo/agent-contracts && npm run typecheck -w @pinpawo/pet-agent && npm run typecheck -w @pinpawo/studio && npm run typecheck -w @pinpawo/agent-session && npm run typecheck -w @pinpawo/tui && npm run typecheck -w @pinpawo-toolkit/browser && npm run typecheck -w @pinpawo-plugin/kanban && npm run typecheck -w @pinpawo-plugin/scheduler && npm run typecheck -w @pinpawo-plugin/trigger && npm run typecheck -w @pinpawo-plugin/studio-http && npm run typecheck -w @pinpawo/studio-console && npm run typecheck -w @pinpawo-tests/studio-e2e && npm run test:unit -w pinpawo
scripts.langfuse:up: npm run langfuse:env && docker compose --env-file infra/langfuse/.env -f infra/langfuse/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.langfuse:down: npm run langfuse:env && docker compose --env-file infra/langfuse/.env -f infra/langfuse/docker-compose.yml down
scripts.langfuse:logs: npm run langfuse:env && docker compose --env-file infra/langfuse/.env -f infra/langfuse/docker-compose.yml logs -f langfuse-web langfuse-worker
scripts.langfuse:ps: npm run langfuse:env && docker compose --env-file infra/langfuse/.env -f infra/langfuse/docker-compose.yml ps
scripts.langfuse:config: npm run langfuse:env && docker compose --env-file infra/langfuse/.env -f infra/langfuse/docker-compose.yml config
